surface: Initial Mapbox GL JS 3.5+ and MapLibre GL JS 4+ entry points with an authored Octane component layer; MapLibre production WebGL, lifecycle, SSR, and public API smoke coverage are verified while exhaustive upstream parity remains in progress.
divergences: Refs are passed as ordinary props instead of React forwardRef wrappers.
React StrictMode's development-only double mount is not reproduced.
The upstream mapbox-legacy entry is not included; Mapbox GL JS 1.13 requires a separate controller and type boundary.
ssr: The component renders its container during SSR and imports/constructs the selected WebGL map library only in a client effect. Child map components mount after the map instance is available.
notes: The token-free MapLibre production browser lane compiles authored source with Vite and verifies construction, controls, overlays, style data, teardown, and remount.
A token-backed modern Mapbox browser lane and exhaustive pristine/adapted upstream parity lanes remain follow-up work.
